open_items: OI-1: 6 reviewed paths are unregistered in runtime/state/artifact_hashes.json, so PROTOCOL rule 2 (artifact sha256 in the registry + reviewer verdict) does not yet permit N0 done. Controller registration action required.

OI-2: numerics/gates.py::_protocol_review has no withdrawal/supersession rule: it counts the withdrawn w081-c8 accept and the self-declared non-counting w012-c3 accept as protocol accepts. Contest flag is correct and fail-closed; the accept list is not.

OI-3: protocol preamble still cites superseded F0 pins 66bf917b/565a6e50 instead of 0abb9ed8a961; rev3 re-binds in class_binding and records the drift. A protocol rev4/erratum is the clean fix, but rewriting the hash-frozen text would void verdicts bound to 1e6cdf04.

OI-4: protocol section 3.2/3.8/6(e) names numerics/tests/n0_order_4rung.json (constant-CFL cfl=0.5 ladder) as the certified 4-rung fit, while rev3 certifies from the fixed-dt certification and demotes that ladder to a mixed-order corroborating control. rev3 documents the supersession in certification_basis.supersedes_evidence_basis; the protocol text still points at the demoted file.
stop_rule: 1 agent-hour; one verdict file + one review event + one checkpoint, then exit.
next_falsifier: Void if any cited path re-hashes to a different sha256 (rev3 da7c3607, protocol 1e6cdf04, certification 1677822c, frozen module 8ade1cdc, F0 0abb9ed8), if a certification row has dt!=1e-4 / fewer than four rungs / a non-monotone ladder, if a recomputed fixed-dt order leaves |p-2|<=0.3 or cross-scheme |dp| exceeds 0.25, if numerics/spherical_solver/ appears while the lock is locked, or if the guard reports production_allowed=true.
